scope: One actual Ditto attack enabled; manual SD100 Dummy Doll physical-card protection corrected.
source: Exact Rainier component text, stable card IDs, primary rule evidence and actual server regressions.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Printed new Ditto exchanges one deck Pokemon on heads, retaining state; physical old card is returned and deck shuffled.
Ditto cannot select an Item Fossil or Hero Spirit Palafin ex. Original prior attacking species remains Ditto, not the replacement Ancient Pokemon.

Ver3.4 D19 p50: inherited same-Ability usage and separate new Ability usage. E19 pp60-61: inspected failed deck searches still shuffle; conditional tails does not inspect/shuffle (inference from card and general rule). C17 p34: applicable attack-effect protection prevents the Pokemon effect, while inspected search still shuffles.
Analogous Zero to Hero exchanges the top Palafin card, retaining Finizen underneath. Retaining lower cards for an evolved copier of Ditto is an inference from the same card-exchange mechanism.
Dummy Doll protection is tied to the original physical Mimikyu V card and does not carry to a replacing card, even another Mimikyu V. Position changes of the same card do not clear it.

evidence.name: Surprisingly Transform
evidence.textEn: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.
evidence.textZh: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则选择自己牌库中的1张宝可梦，与这只宝可梦互换（放于其身上的卡牌、伤害指示物、特殊状态、效果等会全部继承）。如果互换了的话，则将这张卡牌放回牌库。并重洗牌库。

manualRuleCorrections.change: Explicit bound_to_top_card=true; same-card switching retains protection, physical replacement removes it, ordinary equal protection remains independently inherited, original duration unchanged.
